activations.name: Illumination
activations.description: The light blazes out, illuminating the area with brilliant starlight that harms the undead.
activations.notes: Canonical LightArea preserves illumination, but the catalog has no activation-eligible action parameter for the legacy eight-ray undead damage component.

activations.name: Magic Mapping
activations.description: The entire level is revealed in your mind's eye.

activations.name: Detection
activations.description: You sense all creatures, objects, traps, and paths nearby.

activations.name: Protection from Evil
activations.description: A holy aura wards off evil creatures.
activations.notes: Duration base is 0; the runtime multiplies dice.count by player level (3*level ticks).

activations.name: Dispel Evil
activations.description: Holy light blasts all evil creatures in sight.
activations.notes: Damage scales with player level at runtime (5 * player_level). flat_bonus=0 is a placeholder; runtime replaces it. The catalog has DispelByTag, but activation is not an allowed source family; the legacy holy burst and evil-target filter remain unresolved.

activations.name: Bizarre
activations.description: The One Ring pulses with terrible power, producing an utterly unpredictable effect.
activations.notes: The One Ring's unique activation. Runtime selects randomly from a pool of drastic effects. No canonical action models this random pool; an activation-specific random-effect action is required.

activations.name: Phase Door
activations.description: You blink a short distance to an adjacent open area.

activations.name: Starlight
activations.description: Eight beams of starlight streak outward, burning undead.
activations.notes: Canonical LightArea preserves illumination, but the catalog has no activation-eligible action parameter for the legacy eight-ray undead damage component.

activations.name: Shard Bolt
activations.description: A jagged bolt of razor shards screams toward your target.

activations.name: Fire Bolt
activations.description: A bolt of fire leaps from the artifact toward your target.

activations.name: Frost Bolt
activations.description: A bolt of intense cold streaks toward your target.

activations.name: Lightning Bolt
activations.description: A bolt of lightning crackles outward.

activations.name: Stinking Cloud
activations.description: A noxious cloud of poison gas billows outward.

activations.name: Frost Ball
activations.description: A ball of intense cold erupts from the artifact.

activations.name: Frost Ball III
activations.description: A powerful ball of freezing cold erupts outward.

activations.name: Frost Ball IV
activations.description: A devastating ball of freezing cold annihilates everything nearby.

activations.name: Frost Ball V
activations.description: An enormous ball of killing cold detonates, chilling all in its radius.

activations.name: Fire Ball
activations.description: A ball of roaring fire blossoms from the artifact.

activations.name: Ball of Fire
activations.description: A massive fireball erupts from the artifact.

activations.name: Fire Ball II
activations.description: A large fireball detonates with tremendous force.

activations.name: Lightning Ball
activations.description: A ball of crackling lightning explodes outward from the artifact.

activations.name: Acid Bolt
activations.description: A bolt of sizzling acid arcs toward your target.

activations.name: Drain Life
activations.description: Dark energy drains the life-force of your target, healing you in return.
activations.notes: The catalog has DrainLife, but activation is not an allowed source family. The legacy nether bolt and life-restoration semantics remain unresolved.

activations.name: Drain Life II
activations.description: A powerful drain tears vital essence from your target, restoring your own health.
activations.notes: The catalog has DrainLife, but activation is not an allowed source family. The legacy nether bolt and life-restoration semantics remain unresolved.

activations.name: Star Ball
activations.description: Eight balls of brilliant starlight streak outward, each scorching enemies with holy radiance.
activations.notes: Fires 8 ordered BallDamage actions. Each deals 6d7 light damage with radius 3.

activations.name: Magic Missile
activations.description: A bolt of pure arcane force speeds toward your target.

activations.name: Mana Bolt
activations.description: A bolt of raw magical force blasts toward your target.

activations.name: Magical Arrow
activations.description: A magical arrow of great force speeds toward your target.

activations.name: Heal
activations.description: Powerful healing magic restores a significant portion of your health.

activations.name: Heal II
activations.description: Powerful magic knits your wounds, restoring a great deal of health.

activations.name: Cure Wounds
activations.description: Minor healing magic mends your wounds.

activations.name: Restore Life Levels
activations.description: The artifact restores life levels drained by undead and demons.

activations.name: Haste
activations.description: You move with supernatural speed.

activations.name: Haste I
activations.description: You move with sustained supernatural speed.

activations.name: Haste II
activations.description: Your body quickens to incredible speed.

activations.name: Berserk Strength
activations.description: Battle-rage floods through you; your blows land with terrible force.

activations.name: Identify
activations.description: The artifact reveals the true nature of an item.

activations.name: Probe
activations.description: The artifact reveals the true nature and remaining health of all nearby creatures.
activations.notes: The catalog has InspectEntity, but activation is not an allowed source family. Probe remains unresolved.

activations.name: Clairvoyance
activations.description: Your mind expands to encompass the entire level, detecting all creatures, objects, traps, and passages.

activations.name: Confuse Monster
activations.description: A blast of disorienting magic befuddles your target.
activations.notes: ConfuseControl exists, but activation is not an allowed source family. The canonical payload remains pending source-family/catalog resolution.

activations.name: Sleep Monsters
activations.description: Soothing magic lulls nearby monsters into a deep slumber.
activations.notes: The catalog has SleepControl, but activation is not an allowed source family. Sleep remains unresolved.

activations.name: Remove Fear and Poison
activations.description: The artifact cleanses you of fear and neutralizes all poison in your blood.
activations.notes: The catalog has CureStatus, but activation is not an allowed source family. Both fear and poison cures remain unresolved.

activations.name: Elemental Resistance
activations.description: A protective aura wards off fire, cold, acid, and lightning.

activations.name: Rage, Bless, and Resist
activations.description: You are flooded with battle-fury, divine blessing, and elemental protection simultaneously.

activations.name: Teleport
activations.description: You are whisked away to a random location on the level.

activations.name: Teleport Away
activations.description: A directed force hurls your target to a distant part of the dungeon.
activations.notes: The catalog has TeleportTarget, but activation is not an allowed source family. The legacy forced target relocation remains unresolved.

activations.name: Word of Recall
activations.description: After a short delay, you are recalled to the surface.
activations.notes: RecallOrLevelShift exists, but activation is not an allowed source family. The canonical payload remains pending source-family/catalog resolution.

activations.name: Banishment
activations.description: A wave of holy power banishes all evil creatures from the level.

activations.name: Mass Banishment
activations.description: Every non-unique creature on the level is banished to the void.

activations.name: Stone to Mud
activations.description: The artifact dissolves rock walls to muddy rubble with a touch.
activations.notes: BeamDamage is not activation-eligible. AlterTerrain cannot preserve the directed stone-to-mud beam's damage component, so this activation remains unresolved.

activations.name: Destroy Traps and Doors
activations.description: All traps and doors in the area are instantly destroyed.

activations.name: Recharge
activations.description: The artifact channels magical energy into an exhausted device, restoring its charges.
